memory_candidates.content: In this repo, `@`-references inside CLAUDE.md merge-source content (e.g. 'Full documentation: @.claude/context/patterns/X.md') are NOT auto-expanded into every agent prompt -- they only resolve when the target file's index-entries.json load_when matches the current agent/command/task_type. Do not assume a file pointed to by an @-reference in an always-loaded file is itself always-loaded; check its own load_when entry.

docs/templates/agent-template.md and context/templates/agent-template.md in agent-system/extensions/core are a deliberate two-tier split (user-facing tutorial vs. canonical meta-builder-agent structure), not accidental duplication -- context/templates/agent-template.md:1-5 explicitly documents the split. When a frontmatter-standard task updates one, check the other for staleness rather than assuming redundancy.

Rule U (per-section line budget gate in check-extension-docs.sh, enforced via extension-slim-standard.md) caps an extension's EXTENSION.md at 60 lines as a hard failure. Before relocating large doc sections into an extension's EXTENSION.md, always check current line count against this cap -- e.g. literature/EXTENSION.md was 33 lines and could not absorb a 162-line section without failing the gate; the correct target for large relocated content is the extension's own merge-sources/claudemd.md instead.
